rules.name: GSTIN Verification
rules.expected: Valid 15-character GSTIN must be present and not negated
rules.suggestion: Include a valid 15-digit GSTIN (format: 22AAAAA0000A1Z5) in the bid document. Ensure it is not marked as 'not available' or 'N/A'.

rules.name: PAN Verification
rules.expected: Valid 10-character PAN must be present and not negated
rules.suggestion: Include the bidder's 10-character PAN (format: ABCDE1234F) in the bid document.

rules.name: Bid Validity Period
rules.expected: Bid validity must be at least 90 days
rules.suggestion: State a bid validity period of at least 90 days (e.g. 'Bid Validity: 120 days').

rules.name: EMD / Earnest Money Deposit
rules.expected: EMD or Bid Security must be mentioned with an actual amount
rules.suggestion: Include details of Earnest Money Deposit (EMD) or Bid Security with the actual amount enclosed.

rules.name: Authorised Signatory
rules.expected: Document must be signed by an authorised signatory — keyword must not be negated
rules.suggestion: Include the name and designation of the Authorised Signatory. The signatory must not be described as absent or missing.

rules.name: Annual Turnover
rules.expected: Annual turnover must be at least ₹5,00,000
rules.suggestion: Declare an annual turnover of at least ₹5,00,000 with supporting documents (e.g. audited balance sheet).

rules.name: Udyam / MSME Registration
rules.expected: Udyam/MSME registration should be mentioned if applicable
rules.suggestion: If the bidder is an MSME, include the Udyam Registration Number (format: UDYAM-XX-00-0000000).

rules.name: Delivery Period
rules.suggestion: Clearly state the delivery period or dispatch timeline in the bid (e.g. 'Delivery within 30 days of PO').

rules.name: Make in India Compliance
rules.expected: Make in India / local content declaration if applicable
rules.suggestion: Include a Make in India declaration with local content percentage if applicable.

rules.name: Warranty / Guarantee
rules.expected: Warranty or guarantee terms must be specified
rules.suggestion: Specify warranty/guarantee period and terms in the bid (e.g. '12 months warranty from date of delivery').

rules.name: OEM Authorisation
rules.suggestion: If the bidder is a reseller, include an OEM Authorisation Certificate issued by the manufacturer.

rules.name: Payment Terms
rules.expected: Payment terms must be clearly defined
rules.suggestion: State payment terms (e.g. 'payment within 30 days of delivery and acceptance').

rules.name: Technical Specifications
rules.suggestion: Include detailed technical specifications matching the GeM catalogue listing.

rules.name: Past Performance / Experience
rules.expected: Evidence of past performance or experience
rules.suggestion: Include evidence of past performance — prior purchase orders or client references.

rules.name: Compliance Certificates
rules.expected: Relevant compliance/quality certificates must be attached
rules.suggestion: Attach relevant compliance certificates (ISO, BIS, CE, test reports) as required by the tender.
